combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Musical Instruments × Greek Mythology

entries.clue: Saws and planes timber on site, framing stud walls and raising roof trusses
Cuts and beds stone, tapping each course true against a taut line
Told the one-eyed shepherd his name was Nobody; took ten years sailing home
Raised metal bar on a neck that stops a string at an exact pitch
Two feet of silver blown sideways across a hole, airy and pure up at the top
A swan to Leda, a bull to Europa, a shower of gold to Danae; one shape-shifter
Tall folded wooden body, the orchestra's low-voiced clown with a curved crook
Indian hand drums, one deep and one high, played with fingers and palm heel
Prince who trailed thread through the man-eater's maze but forgot his white sails
Tamps the grounds, steams the milk and draws a leaf in your flat white
Greek trio who spin, measure and snip the thread of every mortal life
Hanging bronze circle struck once and left to shiver for an age
